messages:
Maya: Heads up — guest mic on Stage 2 is cutting out. AV says aux feed is clean. We need a quick swap and a note to leadership that the Q+A order might shift. Can audio/streaming do the switch now?
Frank: On it. I can switch OBS to aux in 30s. Will route main mix to iso recorder first.
Leah: If someone's swapping decks, pls upload the final slides to /allhands/decks now — I just pushed a small edit.
Sanjay: Captions might desync for a minute during the switch. I'll enable low-latency mode but expect a small catch-up.
David: If Q&A order changes, ping me — I'll update the op note so hosts know who to call next.
Frank: Switching OBS now — command in case people want to mirror:
```
# in prod obs machine
SceneCollection.Switch "AllHands_Aux"
AudioOutput.SetSource "AuxFeed"
```
Frank: Done. Aux feed live. Please confirm on your end. :white_check_mark:
Leah: Confirmed slides are the new version and are on the presenter laptop. Uploaded to the drive too.
Sanjay: Captions caught up, latency ~1.2s now. Will keep low-latency for remainder of segment.
Maya: Great — Olivia, heads up: we might do your leadership Q&A after the demo so we don't scramble speakers. Any objections? @Olivia (CEO)
Olivia (CEO): OK with moving Q&A after demo if it helps flow. Let's just call it out at top of segment so ppl don't jump in early.
David: I'll add a 30s buffer and tell hosts to hold mic for Olivia until cue.
stream-bot: [automated] Live stream health crossing threshold: CPU 72%, Encode buffer 2% -> OK
Maya: Also quick recorder note — if anyone wants raw iso, Frank left /recordings/stage2/ongoing. We'll splice if needed.
Leah: Might need a small edit for slide timing in clip — I'll flag timestamps post event.
Sanjay: If captions have regression in post, we can re-sync using the iso audio track.
Maya: Thanks team. Will post a short postmortem note in #all-hands after. :thumbsup:
